_about: Raags, taals and notation symbols the keertan books print, keyed once for both the pipeline and the web app. The mirror packages/search-core/src/notation-vocab.json must be byte-identical (tools/sync-notation-vocab.mjs). English aliases marked in `banidb` are the spellings BaniDB's /v2/raags returns; the corpus's shabads.raag is checked against them by a corpus-gated test. Sections carry Devanagari and Latin labels too; a Paluskar book (sam 1, khali +, tali as matra numbers, duration marks under the bols) is not parsed in this version.
